module: GE extension `core_multiseat`: local multiplayer management (several players on the same PC: keyboard/mouse and controllers). It decides which player (index 0, 1, 2...) controls each input device, either by manual assignment (per device), or by device groups managed by the platform (console user accounts). It maintains the list of 'joined' players (joinedPlayers) with their persona (name, icon, color via core_playerPersonas), places players in vehicles, displays player tags (render_playerTags), colors the devices and emits onLocalParticipantsChanged. Most functions are called by core_input_bindings and by the multiseat UI.
usage:
if settings.getValue('multiseat') then
  for _, p in ipairs(core_multiseat.getParticipants()) do
    log('I','', p.persona.displayName .. ' -> player ' .. p.assignment.playerIndex)
  end
end
notes: Vocabulary: 'player' = player index (0-based, at most 64: maxPlayers hardcoded 'to be aligned with the limit of the steering fast path on the C++ side'); 'persona' = identity numbered from 1 (core_playerPersonas); 'participant' = { id, persona, assignment, inputIcon } where assignment = { playerIndex, devices, deviceIds, primaryDeviceId, deviceLabel, connectedDeviceLabel, connectedInputIcon, connected }.

Input devices: `devices` is the table provided by core_input_bindings: device name -> { guid, productName, pidvid, playerNumber, platformUserNumber } (indices 1 to 5). The keyboard and mouse are grouped as a single 'device' (id 'keyboard-mouse') in the assignment lists.

Two assignment modes: manual (manuallyAssignedPlayers, one index per device, -1 = unassigned; cycleDevicePlayer cycles through) or platform-managed (Input.getPlatformUserCount() non-nil: platformDeviceGroupPlayers, one index per device group, via assignDeviceGroup). Without a true 'multiseat' setting, all devices belong to player 0.

normalizePlayerAssignments (internal) renumbers the players so that they are contiguous from 0, in persona number order. getAssignedPlayers does this work on every call from core_input_bindings, stores the assignment, updates activePlayers/joinedPlayers and can place on-foot players in the least occupied vehicle (seatPlayers).

Configuration editing: beginConfigurationEdit/endConfigurationEdit freeze the real assignments while the UI composes a configuration. applyConfiguration(config) validates it (resolveConfiguration), takes a snapshot (exportConfiguration), applies it via core_input_bindings.applyPlayerAssignments, and restores the snapshot on failure. With config.deferParticipantNotification, the notification is postponed until finalizeConfiguration().
Emitted hooks: onLocalParticipantsChanged(revision); UI event LocalParticipantsChanged(participants, revision). The 'revision' = internal counter + core_playerPersonas revision.

Bug/inconsistency: getPlayerMarkersEnabled reads the 'multiseatTags' setting as a boolean and, if the value is not one (for example the string 'always'/'smart'/'never' written by core_multiseatPlayerMarkers), replaces it with true/false in the settings (overwriting the old string). The two modules do not share the same format.
Inconsistency: at load nextMockPlatformDeviceGroupId is 1 but reset() sets it back to 0 (only affects the debugMockPlatformUsers debug mode).
M.allowTrafficDebug is set to false and is not used anywhere in this file.

reset() (called at the end of the level) clears players, personas, assignments and device colors, sets activePlayers = {0} and disables the 'multiseat' setting if this session had enabled it (personaOptInMode or multiseatActive).
onSerialize only returns a snapshot if multiseatActive is true; otherwise nothing is saved. onDeserialized tries to restore the exported configuration.
Player tags (render_playerTags) are only displayed if the multiseat setting is true, more than one player is active and split-screen is not loaded (render_splitScreen then handles the tags).

allowTrafficDebug.desc: false. Not used in this file.

getAssignedPlayers.desc: Computes which player controls each device, applies it via assignPlayerToDevice and updates the internal state (active players, personas). During a configuration edit, returns 'safe' assignments without modifying them. Called by core_input_bindings.

devices.desc: device name -> { guid, productName, pidvid, playerNumber, platformUserNumber }.

logEnabled.desc: Writes the number of players and the assignments to the log.

seatPlayers.desc: If true, makes on-foot players enter the least occupied vehicle and makes those who became inactive exit.

getPlayers.desc: Fills and returns the ordered list of currently active player indices.

getDeviceAssignments.desc: Lists, for the UI, the 'devices' (keyboard+mouse grouped, controllers) with their manually assigned player: { id, deviceIds, primaryDeviceId, deviceLabel, inputIcon, playerIndex, connected, deviceMetadata }.

getDeviceAssignmentsFor.desc: Parameterized version of getDeviceAssignments for provided devices and assignments.

getDeviceGroups.desc: Platform device groups (one per user account), with the assigned player; includes assigned but disconnected groups (connected = false).

returns.desc: Elements { id, groupId, playerIndex, label, devices, connected }.

assignDeviceGroup.desc: Assigns a platform device group to a player (or -1 to unassign). Refuses if the platform does not manage players, if the group does not exist or if the player is already taken by another group.

returns.desc: true if the assignment was made.

getDeviceGroupForPlayer.desc: Returns the device group assigned to a player.

isPlatformManagingPlayers.desc: Indicates whether the platform (console, Steam...) manages players itself: Input.getPlatformUserCount() non-nil (or debug mode).

cycleDevicePlayer.desc: Moves a device (or the keyboard+mouse group) to the next player in the cycle (player 0, -1 unassigned, then previous player...), renumbers the players and updates core_input_bindings. Refused if the platform manages players.

getParticipants.desc: Returns the participants (persona + assignment). With no argument and if there are joined players, these are the joined players; otherwise the active players (with a preview persona if not joined).

getAvailableParticipants.desc: Participants available for the UI: for each active player, { id = 'local-player:N', assignment, inputIcon, joined, persona (real if joined, otherwise preview) }.

getJoinedParticipants.desc: Participants of the joined players, sorted by player index.

getJoinedPlayers.desc: Sorted indices of the players that have joined (with persona).

joinPlayer.desc: Makes an active player join: assigns it the first free persona number (default persona), renumbers and notifies. Returns true if already joined.

returns.desc: false if the player is not active or there is no room left.

leavePlayer.desc: Removes a joined player: clears its persona and frees its devices or group, then notifies.

returns.desc: false if the player had not joined.

clearJoinedPlayers.desc: Removes all joined players and clears all personas.

setPersonaOptInMode.desc: Enables or disables the mode where players must join explicitly (instead of getting a persona automatically). Enabling it clears the joined players.

getParticipantRevision.desc: Returns the participants revision (internal counter + core_playerPersonas revision), to detect changes.

getPlayerMarkersEnabled.desc: Indicates whether player tags are enabled ('multiseatTags' boolean setting, default true). Converts an old string value to a boolean ('never' = false). See the notes on the inconsistency with core_multiseatPlayerMarkers.

setPlayerPersona.desc: Sets the persona of a joined player (name, icon, color, vehicle) and notifies.

returns.desc: false if the player has not joined or the data is invalid.

clearPlayerPersona.desc: Resets a joined player's persona to its default values and notifies.

returns.desc: false if the player has not joined.

exportConfiguration.desc: Exports the full multiseat state (assignments, joined players, personas, caches) as a copyable table, used as a snapshot for restoration or Lua reload.

resolveConfiguration.desc: Validates and normalizes a configuration proposed by the UI: renumbers the players from 0 according to persona number order and translates the device/group assignments.

config.desc: { participants = [{ playerIndex, personaNumber, persona }], manualAssignments, groupAssignments, platformManagesPlayers, personaOptInMode, manualDeviceMetadata, platformDeviceGroups }.

returns.desc: Resolved configuration { platformManagesPlayers, personaOptInMode, manualAssignments, groupAssignments, assignments, participants, personas, ... }.

applyConfiguration.desc: Applies a multiseat configuration: enables the 'multiseat' setting and the action map, installs the assignments, personas and players, with automatic restoration on error.

config.desc: See resolveConfiguration; extra fields: multiseatActive (default true), deferParticipantNotification.

restoreConfiguration.desc: Restores a snapshot produced by exportConfiguration (protected by pcall, refused during an applyConfiguration) and notifies.

finalizeConfiguration.desc: Finishes a deferred application: updates the pending assignment cache and emits the participants notification.

returns.desc: false if there was nothing to finalize.

cachePlayerAssignments.desc: Builds the cache (device/group owners by persona number) from a configuration and stores it in ui_multiseat_assignmentCache.

returns.desc: false if the config is invalid.

getCachedPlayerAssignments.desc: Returns the assignment cache stored in ui_multiseat_assignmentCache.

isApplyingConfiguration.desc: Indicates whether applyConfiguration is in progress.

beginConfigurationEdit.desc: Starts an editing session: getAssignedPlayers then returns frozen assignments instead of recomputing.

endConfigurationEdit.desc: Ends the editing, and optionally stores the provided device and assignment state.

isConfigurationEditActive.desc: Indicates whether a configuration edit is in progress.

previewDeviceColors.desc: Shows on the devices the player colors of a configuration still being edited (core_devices.setPlayerColors).

config.desc: Configuration to preview; nil clears the colors.

clearDeviceColors.desc: Removes the player colors from the devices, if they had been applied.

setMultiseatActive.desc: Marks multiseat as active (multiseat session in progress).

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook (only when a level is loaded): synchronizes the device colors and displays/updates the player tags (render_playerTags), unless split-screen is loaded.

onLanguageChanged.desc: Language change hook: resynchronizes the joined players, invalidates the personas (translated names) and notifies.

onClientEndMission.desc: End of level: resets the whole multiseat state (see notes, reset()).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: On unload: destroys the player tags and removes the device colors.

onSerialize.desc: Before a Lua reload: destroys tags and colors, and returns a snapshot if multiseat is active.

returns.desc: Snapshot, or nil if multiseat is inactive.

onDeserialized.desc: After a Lua reload: restores the configuration from the snapshot.
